  "evidence": [
    {
      "command": "git diff e278496f0^ e278496f0 -- (production and test files); subject.json and reviewedTree of this round",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "The commit changes 12 files (371 lines added, 12 removed). The subject is commit e278496f0 on parent 7db01934f, tree ff243fa6866c3dc54e71f53b5a6f853e5a7d7966. Production changes: internal/delegation/phases.go (a job cancel of a unit reservation whose launch was never created now settles it as cancelled and never run, through ReconcileUnitLaunch), internal/dispatch/unit_launch.go (start and end times are compared only for an outcome that actually ran), internal/launch/unit_accounting.go (a cancelled run's collection also picks up a starting step's launch id and a comparison with no recorded end, and settles each as never created), internal/launch/tree_reservation.go (CancelRun now also cancels the last round's base comparisons, collects every round after the children are proven ended, and adds the neverCreated helper), cmd/metasystem/intent_process.go and intent_tree.go (work stop takes --reason; recordWorkStop keeps the reason as a 'work-stop' override record before the stop). About 66 production lines against an estimate of 63. This matches brief Contracts 1 to 7 for U5a."
    },
    {
      "command": "Read memory/rulings.md (the standing rulings register) and the goal's human decisions via the main engine: metasystem goal show a-round-ends-without-its-caller --history --json",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Rulings read, including R-124-m1u (smallest thing that works), R-129-ui (acts are idempotent), R-142-m1e (the machine never overrules a person; record who, when, what and why), R-143-m1e (state the impact before an override) and R-147-m1k. The goal's Intent and NextStep ask for 'settle a cancelled, never-executed unit reservation through cancel or collection with a terminal record and zero charge... cancelling before launch frees an active-job slot and the next launch is admitted. work stop JOB takes --reason.' The human history entries are a tier override and priority reorderings. No conflict: the commit implements exactly that, and a repeated stop writes nothing (R-129)."
    },
    {
      "command": "cat /Users/wido/.metasystem/unit/20261116t021948-f3a69b3d36/round-1/check-1086117500/output.log (tail)",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "The engine's frozen unit check on this build passed: every landing group was green, including unit/cmd/metasystem, unit/internal/launch, unit/internal/dispatch and unit/internal/delegation, with LANDING-CHECKED 0. The TestAudit run (message and layout audits) printed ok."
    },
    {
      "command": "go test ./internal/dispatch ./internal/launch ./internal/delegation -run 'TestANeverExecutedSettlementFreesItsSlot|TestBookEndedRead|TestCancelOf|TestCancelRefuses|TestCancelConcludes|TestReconcileRepairs|TestCancelRun' -count=1 (at HEAD e278496f0, clean worktree)",
      "level": "ran",
      "observed": "All three packages printed ok."
    },
    {
      "command": "go test ./cmd/metasystem -run 'TestAStoppedRun|TestAReasonThatCannotBeKept|TestIntentIdempotency' -count=1 -v",
      "level": "ran",
      "observed": "These passed: TestAStoppedRunFreesTheSlotItsUnstartedJobHeld (brief test T3), TestAStoppedRunEndsItsComparison (T5) and TestAReasonThatCannotBeKeptDoesNotStopALaunch. A wider run that included TestIntentTree failed only because the sandbox blocked git's xcrun cache file ('Operation not permitted'). That is an environment limit, not a code defect, and the engine's unit check ran the same tests green."
    },
    {
      "command": "Read internal/launch/unit_run.go:255-330 (Advance) and internal/launch/read_sequence.go:40-180 (startStep)",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Advance holds the run lock across the driver's step start and refuses a cancelled run. CancelRun marks the run cancelled under the same lock. So the new collection of a cancelled run's never-created starting launch cannot race a live driver creating that launch through the run path. A plain job cancel can still race it, but that race already existed and the brief names it as rare case U5-L7."
    },
    {
      "command": "Read the other callers of stopResolvedJob: intent_machine.go:1159 (machine stop) and intent_process.go:850-920 (cancelCheckoutLaunches, used by system stop)",
      "level": "read",
      "observed": "Neither system stop nor machine stop registers a --reason flag, so recordWorkStop writes nothing on those paths. Their behaviour is unchanged."
    }
  ],
  "findings": [
    {
      "change": "None needed now. If it ever matters, the impact line could say the stop was requested rather than that it happened.",
      "claim": "The stop's reason is written before the stop is tried. When the stop is then refused (for example CancelRun returns 'tree waiting' because a mutation is still live, or the delegate refuses the dispatch cancel), a record saying 'TARGET stops and is not restarted' remains even though nothing stopped. Each retry writes another record, because the run or job has still not ended.",
      "class": "other",
      "evidence": "cmd/metasystem/intent_tree.go:127-132 writes the record before runner.CancelRun, which can return TreeWaitingError (internal/launch/tree_reservation.go, the CancelRun prelude). cmd/metasystem/intent_process.go stopResolvedJob writes it before cancelDispatch, which can refuse. This matches the brief (Contract 5: written before the stop takes effect) and the documented behaviour of recordUnitStopOverride ('Failed commands retain that admission evidence'). The slice works and is safe without a change.",
      "id": "N-1",
      "material": false,
      "relation": "R-143-m1e (the impact is stated before the effect)",
      "resolves": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "where": "metasystem/cmd/metasystem/intent_process.go"
    },
    {
      "change": "None needed. The slice works and is safe without it.",
      "claim": "ReconcileUnitLaunch no longer compares times for an outcome that did not run.       "class": "other",
      "evidence": "internal/dispatch/unit_launch.go:147-153: once the contradiction check passes for an outcome with executed false, the code returns early only when cause is not 'environment' or unitEnvironment is already true; otherwise it falls through to rewrite the status and times. The charge stays zero, so there is no effect on the budget.",
      "id": "N-2",
      "material": false,
      "relation": "R-129-ui (acts are idempotent)",
      "resolves": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "where": "metasystem/internal/dispatch/unit_launch.go"
    },
    {
      "change": "None needed now. Possibly word it as 'could not be settled' later.",
      "claim": "When the new never-created path in internalCancel reaches ReconcileUnitLaunch and that call fails (for example because it contradicts an earlier settlement), the delegate reports 'unit launch ... could not be proven ended', which is misleading: no launch existed. The same misleading wording already applied to the launched case before this change.",
      "class": "other",
      "evidence": "internal/delegation/phases.go:177-199: the err != nil branch after the reconcile always dies with 'cancel refused: unit launch %s could not be proven ended (%v)'. The cause is still printed inside the parentheses, so the wording is only imprecise.",
      "id": "N-3",
      "material": false,
      "relation": "R-124-m1u (later list, not a fix round)",
      "resolves": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "where": "metasystem/internal/delegation/phases.go"
    }
